title: Add modular RAG templates with live-assertion harness quickstart
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add a modular RAG quickstart with a small local runner and a live-assertion harness for deterministic template testing; includes examples in TypeScript and Python, CI job to run assertions, and docs updates.
description: Context and motivation: This PR introduces a compact, modular RAG template library and a small 'live-assertion' harness that lets developers assert retrieval coverage and deterministic template outputs against a controllable local dataset. Motivation: onboarding teams often copy/paste monolithic RAG examples and lack tooling to lock down retrieval/formatting regressions. The goal is a lightweight example that demonstrates: 1) How to compose modular prompt templates (instruction, retrieval, fuse, post-process) 2) How to run assertions against a local index/dataset to catch regressions early 3) How to run the same checks from CI via a small workflow. What we changed (high level): - New examples/rag-modular-templates/ package with canonical template and two reference adapters (ts/python). - A tiny local runner (examples/rag-modular-templates/runner/) that can run against an in-memory faiss-like shim or a small sqlite-backed docstore for reproducible tests. - A live-assertion harness (examples/rag-modular-templates/assertions/) where developers declare expected retrieval answers and generated snippets; harness fails on divergence. - Docs: docs/quickstarts/rag-modular-templates.md with step-by-step guide, troubleshooting, and CI integration section. - CI: .github/workflows/rag-assertions.yml that spins a matrix for node/python and runs harness smoke tests. - Telemetry probes: probes/telemetry-template-metrics.md and a small instrumentation shim to emit token/latency breakdowns for examples. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of modular template library (TS + Python) - [x] Local runner & simple docstore shim - [x] Assertion harness + example assertion set - [x] CI workflow for assertions - [x] Documentation and quickstart guide - [x] Example README with commands and expected output - [x] Linting & unit test coverage for examples Related work: See ENG-2248 for the broader RAG templates initiative. This PR builds on concepts from PRs that added local playback harnesses and testbenches (see related PRs linked in the ticket). Commands to try locally: - npm ci && npm run start:local (TS runner) - python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r examples/rag-modular-templates/py-requirements.txt && python examples/rag-modular-templates/runner/py_runner.py - ./examples/rag-modular-templates/assertions/run_assertions.sh (runs both languages) Summary of commits: - feat(rag-templates): scaffold modular template package (initial) - feat(runner): add lightweight local runner and sqlite docstore shim - feat(assertions): assertion harness and example assertion set - docs: add quickstart and CI integration guide - ci: add rag-assertions workflow and small test matrix - fix(lint): address ts lint errors from CI - chore: small Python packaging and requirements cleanups Changed areas / files (representative): - examples/rag-modular-templates/package.json - examples/rag-modular-templates/src/templates/*.ts - examples/rag-modular-templates/py_templates/*.py - examples/rag-modular-templates/runner/py_runner.py - examples/rag-modular-templates/runner/ts_runner.ts - examples/rag-modular-templates/assertions/example_assertions.yml - docs/quickstarts/rag-modular-templates.md - .github/workflows/rag-assertions.yml Review thread and decisions (condensed): - Priya: "Can the assertion harness run only retrieval assertions (no generation) to reduce flakiness?" — Author: "Yes; harness supports retrieval-only mode and fuzzy-match thresholds; docs updated to show both retrieval-only and end-to-end modes." - Miguel: "Nit: prefer explicit template versioning and a short migration note in the docs." — Author: "Added TEMPLATE_VERSION constant and a migration section in docs." - Samir: "CI looks good but add a secret-scoped config so it won't call hosted keys during matrix runs." — Author: "Added CI toggle to run in 'local' mode with in-repo sample keys; doc shows how to switch to hosted keys for e2e." - Priya: "Please add a short Python example to mirror the TS flow." — Author: "Added py_templates and py runner; unit tests added." - Miguel (after fixes): "Approved" - Priya (after fixes): "Approved" - Samir: "Approved" CI checks: - build (node): pass - lint (ts): pass - unit-tests (node): pass - build (python): pass - unit-tests (python): pass - integration/smoke: pass Notes on testing and determinism: The harness emphasizes deterministic retrieval by shipping a small sample dataset and a documented seeding step for the sqlite docstore. Generation assertions are optional and run with a strict/lenient mode to avoid blocking CI on minor phrasing differences. Edge cases & future work: - Add an optional FAISS-backed fixture for higher-fidelity retrieval testing (ENG follow-up). - Instrument example to emit richer per-template telemetry; integrate with Redwood Console example dashboards (future PR). Merge: merged via squash on 2024-10-20. Merge commit summary: "Add modular RAG templates + live assertion harness (TS + Python) and CI smoke checks"
